result.summary: The intersection features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and textured crosswalks at a signalized corner with mixed-use development. However, the crossing distance across the multi-lane arterial is substantial, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible in the current view.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic on City Ave without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads with countdown timers to provide pedestrians with information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace or supplement the textured pavement with high-visibility zebra or continental markings.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalization, but features a wide crossing distance across multiple travel lanes. While the crossing is demarcated with decorative red paving and border lines, it lacks high-visibility continental markings to maximize driver awareness.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing area spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Low-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The decorative red paving lacks high-contrast longitudinal stripes (zebra markings) which are more visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: The red-paved area in the center of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Add continental or zebra-style white markings over the red paving to increase visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features wide multi-lane roadways with signalized crossings and colored pavement for crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distances and wide turning radii create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corners are designed with wide radii, which allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add longitudinal 'zebra' markings to the existing colored crosswalk to increase visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, colored pavement crosswalk and standard sidewalks in a mixed-use commercial area. However, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a pedestrian refuge island increases exposure to vehicle traffic.
